sn20.9:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena aññataro navo bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulāni upasaṅkamati ||
sn20.9:1.7: Ime hi nāma therā bhikkhū kulāni upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññissanti || kim aṅgaṃ panāhanti || || 4
sn20.9:2.1: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || pe|| || nisīdiṃsu || 5 Ekam antam nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn20.9:2.2: Idha bhante aññataro navo bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulāni upasaṅkamati ||
sn20.9:2.5: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vucamāno evam āha ||
sn20.9:2.6: Ime hi nāma therā bhikkhū kulāni upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññissanti || kim aṅgaṃ panāhan ti || || 6
sn20.9:3.3: te taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamulālaṃ abbhuggahetvā suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā akaddamaṃ saṃkharitvā ajjhoharanti || ||
sn20.9:3.4: Tesan taṃ vaṇṇāya ceva hoti balāya ca || na ca tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchanti maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ || || 7.
sn20.9:3.5: Tesaññeva kho pana bhikkhave mahānāgānaṃ anusikkhamānā taruṇā bhiṅkacchāpā taṃ sarasim ogāhetvā bhisamulālam abbhuggahetvā na suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā sakaddamaṃ saṃkharitvā ajjhoharanti || ||
sn20.9:3.6: Tesaṃ taṃ neva vaṇṇāya ceva hoti na balāya ||
sn20.9:3.7: tato nidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchanti maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ || || 8
sn20.9:4.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave idha therā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisanti || ||
sn20.9:4.4: te taṃ lābham agadhitā amucchitā anajjhāpannā ādīnavadassāvino nissaraṇapaññā paribbhuñjanti || ||
sn20.9:4.5: Tesaṃ taṃ vaṇṇāya ceva hoti balāya ca || na ca tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchatali maraṇattam vā dukkhaṃ || || 9
sn20.9:4.6: Tesaññeva kho pana bhikkhave therānaṃ bhikkhūnam anusikkhamānā navā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya gāmam vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisanti || || 10
sn20.9:4.9: te taṃ lābhaṃ gadhitā mucchitā ajjhāpannā anādīnavadassāvino anissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti || ||
sn20.9:4.10: Tesaṃ taṃ neva vaṇṇāya hoti na balāya || te tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchanti maraṇamattaṃ va dukkaṃ || || 11
sn20.9:4.11: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbam || ||
sn20.9:4.12: Agadhitā amucchitā anajjhāpannā ādīnavadassāvino nissaraṇapaññā lābhaṃ paribhuñjissāmā ti || ||
